statuses.current: No tracked prompt-relevant validation dependency changed; the historical gate remains the last established outcome.
statuses.selective_revalidation_required: Only specific validation scopes changed and should be rerun.
statuses.full_revalidation_required: Core eval/golden/runtime assumptions changed broadly, so the substantive runtime acceptance should be rerun.
statuses.blocked: The current validation environment is not healthy enough to establish a fresh result.
statuses.different_prompt: Both fingerprints are available and prove that the supplied/current prompt differs from the historical prompt.

interpretation_rules: Replay assesses the validity of the historical validation context; it does not infer that prompt text changed unless fingerprints prove it.
A version bump alone does not require prompt revalidation when the tracked validation hashes and model/guidance semantics are unchanged.
A benchmark corpus hash change alone does not invalidate a prompt when the current benchmark suite still passes.
A traceability policy change alone affects provenance/manifest formatting, not the historical prompt gate.
When prompt content is unavailable, replay may identify the exact scopes that need revalidation but must not fabricate their new outcomes.
